reason: I set the time limit, there are no ads and it's only 10 minutes, so it's one of the few phone things I'd allow, and 24,990 a month is nothing next to what we spend on school prep. I'd use the free trial, check the weekly report, and pay for a month if the report shows she's actually learning letters.
objection: I don't want her glued to the phone, and I'm not sure an app's English is good enough for a private school interview. If after two weeks she only wants the mascot and the games and keeps asking for more screen time, I'll cancel.
would_change_my_mind: If the 10-minute limit doesn't really stop the app, or she whines for the phone after it locks, I wouldn't pay.
